notes.title: Closing Grimoire games :(
notes.content:
It's with great sadness that we announce the closing of Grimoire Games.

We thank you all for accompanying our work and our posts. Your support was of great importance to us during this journey.

And as appreciation for your support we are, as of today, giving you Grim Seventh for free to download and play on Steam.
